bio:
Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable).

FamilySearch gives Elizabeth's married name as Millheim (Milheine, Millhime), wife of Jacob Millheim (1830-1908). It shows her in the 1870 and 1880 censuses with children born from 1859 and gives her death as 31 Mar 1917; her Find a Grave entry is indexed as 'Elizabeth Scott Millheim' ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Elizabeth Scott (L1KQ-SRM), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/L1KQ-SRM
